notes: Machine-readable prerequisites for install and first run. Checks are presence/identity only: nothing here executes a provider call, prints a credential, or stands in for an authorization receipt. Satisfy each entry before the work it gates.

prerequisites.label: Python 3 interpreter on PATH
prerequisites.satisfy: Install Python 3 from python.org (macOS/Windows) or your package manager. The control layer is standard library only - no third-party packages to install.

prerequisites.label: Skill folder complete (SKILL.md + control entrypoint)
prerequisites.satisfy: Reinstall from the repository via CONTROL/bundled-skills.txt (see INSTALL.md). Do not copy a partial folder by hand.

prerequisites.label: Skill registered in the installer manifest
prerequisites.satisfy: Keep the line 'drama-song-ad-factory' in CONTROL/bundled-skills.txt without removing pre-existing entries. Source presence alone is not installation (directive 2.4).

prerequisites.label: One shared Claude config root for claude and claude-nine
prerequisites.satisfy: Install one skill folder into the existing config-root skills directory and link it once; both runtimes read it. Never point either runtime at its own config directory and never create a second claude-nine skills root (repository rule 10).

prerequisites.label: Skill discoverable in both runtimes
prerequisites.satisfy: Confirm the skill appears under plain claude and under claude-nine and loads references/, scripts/, assets/ and tests/. Plain claude stays non-routed (repository rule 9).

prerequisites.label: Skill smoke + parity tests pass
prerequisites.satisfy: Both print ALL PASS. PARITY UNDETERMINED (canonical core tree absent) is recorded as undetermined, never as a pass; re-run where the canonical tree exists before claiming parity.

prerequisites.label: Writable approved storage root for campaign artifacts
prerequisites.satisfy: Choose one approved root for campaign state and artifacts and pass it to preflight. References outside that root are rejected (reference-outside-approved-storage).

prerequisites.label: Recorded authorization scope before paid work
prerequisites.satisfy: Record the authorization scope (ceiling, currency, expiry, allowed repair behavior) and pass it to preflight. Without it preflight exits 4 / approval-missing. A supplied maximum is NOT an approval receipt; never invent a ceiling or an approval.

prerequisites.label: KIE API credential present by name (presence-only check)
prerequisites.satisfy: Set KIE_API_KEY in the host environment (never in this folder, never in the repository). Preflight verifies presence by name only and never prints the value; values are masked to at most first 3 and last 3 characters if a diagnostic must reference them.

prerequisites.label: Provider helper skills 66 (image), 67 (video), 68 (audio), 74 (live adapter)
prerequisites.satisfy: Install the helpers (registration lives in installer-registration/helper-dependencies.json with pinned versions and hashes). If one is absent, preflight fails with module-unavailable naming it - install the helper, never bypass the check and never substitute a static provider path.

prerequisites.label: Provider callback relay skill 46
prerequisites.satisfy: Install 46-kie-callback-relay for asynchronous provider completion callbacks. Do not assume it handles every new payload type without auditing; audit before relying on it for a new callback family (directive 5.1).

prerequisites.label: FFmpeg on PATH for assembly/export
prerequisites.satisfy: Install FFmpeg. Request it explicitly with preflight --require-tool ffmpeg so absence surfaces as tool-unavailable instead of a late failure.

prerequisites.label: Model/provider discovery is live, never a hardcoded table
prerequisites.satisfy: Resolve model and role choices against the live catalog/rules of the current runtime mode. A required model absent from the live catalog stops with a precise error naming the model - never silently downgrade (repository rule 6).

prerequisites.label: No key material inside the skill folder or repository
prerequisites.satisfy: Keep credentials outside the repository. Never commit API docs.md, .env files with real values, router tokens or passwords (repository rules 4 and 5); never print a secret into a transcript or log.
